description: Jinko provides travel infrastructure for AI agents and applications, letting them discover, price, book, and manage flights and hotels. Its platform centers on a shared trip model across MCP, HTTP API, and CLI interfaces.
summary: Jinko exposes a REST API at `api.gojinko.com`, the Jinko Builder MCP server at `https://mcp.builders.gojinko.com/mcp`, and an npm-distributed `jinko` CLI. The MCP server uses OAuth in production, or a `jnk_` API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer`; the REST API takes the key in `X-API-Key`.
